name: pi-teammate
description: A pi extension that turns multiple pi sessions into a collaborative team of AI agents. Instead of a top-down orchestrator dispatching tasks to subordinate subagents, pi-teammate creates a peer network where every agent is equal, can communicate with any other agent, and retains context across tasks.
